recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31793 unless the work group later decides to rename the resource or move the scope clarification out of the current resource narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-31793 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification BRR change request asking that ManufacturedItemDefinition acknowledge that manufacturing is not itself the distinguishing characteristic. The accepted resolution was to add wording explaining that the item is represented in the state it comes from manufacturing, before preparatory steps such as crushing or mixing, and before any separate administrable transformation.
initial_application: The approved wording was applied before this reconciliation to source/manufactureditemdefinition/manufactureditemdefinition-introduction.xml. Git history shows fbfbf287b1ed7a1add0a216ec02cd2d6daab062c added the exact paragraph on 2021-10-07, with 4b8f3f05771e5fc759182d5d0cb02253fa273ef5 carrying the same change the next day.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ManufacturedItemDefinition as an active draft resource with code mid, so the inspected narrative is in current build scope. BRR minutes on 2021-10-07 record the 9-0-0 vote for the FHIR-31793 new resource description, and 2022-02-10 minutes record that the change had been applied. The closely related FHIR-31807 asks for broader ManufacturedItemDefinition explanatory guidance and already has its own audit commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already contains the requested wording at source/manufactureditemdefinition/manufactureditemdefinition-introduction.xml:22-28, and duplicating the same clarification in the StructureDefinition root definition would not materially improve the current specification.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-31807 concerns broader ManufacturedItemDefinition explanatory guidance; it was checked as context and is already represented on the combined branch by its own audit commit.
